comparison.objective: Hang a holder by inserting two keyhole slots over studs and lowering it into bearing.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-feature plate alignment, insertion over headed studs, and gravity seating; no recessed-contact release or wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: Both slots bear on the studs after release and remain still; detailed pose and 1 s hold limits are provided.
comparison.reason: Mounting a plate onto external studs tests simultaneous feature alignment and seating, not tool-mediated terminal depinning.
